registry_info.promotion_rule: Do not replace backend/config/domain_evidence_registry_v1.json until the three-way experiment and regression review pass.
registry_info.medium_signal_rule: A medium signal alone does not scope a query; it needs same-scope high signal, an explicit identifier/system match, or human-approved scope evidence.
registry_info.collision_rule: Signals from multiple scopes keep the query cross_domain until a higher-confidence disambiguator exists.
